heading: Today
text: Patchy dense morning fog, then limited breaks of morning sun giving way to clouds.  Showers developing in NY south of the Adirondacks midday, spreading east and expanding north to Rt. 4 this afternoon, decreasing to spotty in Quebec.  Highs 70 to 75.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Tonight
text: Scattered showers, more numerous south, tapering off.  Gradual clearing.  Patches of fog.  Lows in the 50s, some upper 40s in the Adirondacks.  Winds light, becoming northwest near 10 mph.

heading: Friday
text: Patches of fog early.  Becoming mostly sunny, mixed with some clouds near the mountains.  Cooler.  Highs from the low 60s to low 70s north to south.  Winds northwest, increasing to 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph, becoming more northerly in the afternoon.
